notes: Gloss changed from "chant" to "improvise carelessly": the citation (Amos.6.5, הַפֹּרְטִים עַל פִּי הַנָּבֶל) is part of Amos's condemnation of revelers who lounge and idly make music on instruments while ignoring the nation's crisis -- the pejorative "improvise carelessly" (cf. ESV/NASB "idly strum/improvise") captures that condemnatory context better than the neutral "chant" this root originally shipped with. Revised per confirmation.
